home.intro: 5+ years designing digital experiences across websites, SaaS, CRMs and marketplaces.

items.title: Product & UX Design
items.description: I design digital experiences end-to-end, from problem definition and user flows through interaction, UI, and prototyping.

items.title: UX Research & Strategy
items.description: I use qualitative research, behavioral analysis, and business knowledge to identify problems and turn insights into product opportunities.

items.title: Data-Informed Design & Analytics
items.description: I use product and UX metrics to spot friction, form hypotheses, and evaluate the impact of design decisions.

items.title: CRO & Optimization
items.description: I design and prioritize improvements aimed at reducing friction and improving conversion, defining hypotheses, KPIs, and validation methods.

items.title: Design Systems
items.description: I create and evolve foundations, components, and patterns to build more consistent, accessible, and scalable products.

items.title: Prototyping & Usability Testing
items.description: I turn hypotheses into prototypes and validate them with users before moving into implementation.

items.title: AI & Design-to-Code
items.description: I integrate AI across different stages of the design process and explore workflows that connect design, documentation, and code.

experience.title: My last work experience
experience.p1: Over the past four and a half years, I have worked across two verticals within the same company, splitting my role between TusCasasRurales.com and Pentaweb.

items: Led the interface redesign and built its Design System from scratch, which is currently being implemented.
Designed new features across the traveler experience, private user areas, and internal administration tools.
Redesigned the property owner management platform as part of the product’s long-term evolution, currently awaiting development.

p3.after: , a digital marketing and development agency, I:
items: Designed 30+ corporate websites across different industries, as well as custom digital solutions such as CRMs and management tools.
Created visual identities and brand guidelines for businesses and digital products.
Translated business requirements into user flows, interfaces, and functional solutions.
Collaborated closely with developers throughout the design and implementation process.
